title: Benchmark KRN delivery against a plain harness
body:
Prove the product claim: on a fixed task set, compare plain harness delivery (Codex alone, human merge) with KRN delivery on accepted-first-try rate, escaped defects, human interventions, wall time and tokens, with the same blinded judging as the brain experiment.
Acceptance: a pre-registered comparison with raw per-task results and a stated win/loss per metric.
